title: RePO-VLA: Recovery-Driven Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.09410v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain brittle in long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation because success-only imitation provides little supervision for execution drift, while failed rollouts are often discarded. We introduce RePO-VLA, a recovery-driven policy optimization framework that assigns distinct roles to success, recovery, and failure trajectories. RePO-VLA first applies Recovery-Aware Initialization (RAI), slicing each corrective suffix into a new episode so corrective actions depend on the current adverse state rather than the preceding failure. It then learns a Progress-Aware Semantic Value Function (PAS-VF), aligning spatiotemporal trajectory features with instructions and successful references. The resulting labels salvage useful failure prefixes via reliability decay, while low-value labels mark drift and terminal breakdowns, teaching differences among nominal, failed, and corrective actions. translated_title: RePO-VLA：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的恢复驱动策略优化
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在长时程、接触密集的操作任务中仍然脆弱，这是因为仅基于成功的模仿学习对执行偏差几乎不提供监督信号，而失败的 rollout 轨迹往往被直接丢弃。我们提出了 RePO-VLA，一个恢复驱动的策略优化框架，它为成功、恢复和失败轨迹分配不同的角色。RePO-VLA 首先应用恢复感知初始化（RAI），将每个纠正性后缀切分为新的回合，使纠正动作依赖于当前的不利状态而非先前的失败。接着，它学习一个进度感知语义价值函数（PAS-VF），将时空轨迹特征与指令和成功参考对齐。由此产生的标签通过可靠性衰减挽救有用的失败前缀，而低价值标签则标记漂移和终端崩溃，从而教会模型区分正常动作、失败动作和纠正动作之间的差异。
tldr: RePO-VLA 提出了一种恢复驱动的策略优化框架，通过恢复感知初始化（RAI）和进度感知语义价值函数（PAS-VF）充分利用失败与恢复轨迹，显著提升 VLA 模型在长时程、接触密集操作任务中的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: RePO-VLA is a recovery-driven policy optimization framework that leverages success, recovery, and failure trajectories via Recovery-Aware Initialization and a Progress-Aware Semantic Value Function, enabling VLA models to robustly recover from execution drift in long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation.
